inspiration.observed_pattern: An account listing query builds a recursive category path, preserves account rows through several LEFT JOINs, and attaches a derived ordered GROUP_CONCAT tag list whose inputs combine multiple sources with UNION.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a navigation directory report. A recursive CTE builds a rooted node path, a UNION combines active catalog tags with manually assigned aliases, a grouped derived relation orders those labels with GROUP_CONCAT, and a LEFT JOIN preserves directory nodes with no active labels. SQLite concatenation, date functions, source tables, and application names are not copied.

fixture_notes: Directory nodes 1 through 4 form a rooted tree; node 5 points outside the tree and must not appear. Active catalog tags and manual aliases are combined with UNION, so node 2's repeated external label appears once. Node 3 has only an inactive catalog tag and must remain with '(none)'.
determinism_notes: Node IDs, parent links, tag IDs, active flags, label text, recursive path order, UNION deduplication, GROUP_CONCAT ordering, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE directory_nodes (node_id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT NULL, node_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE directory_tag_catalog (tag_id INT PRIMARY KEY, tag_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, active TINYINT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE directory_node_tags (node_id INT NOT NULL, tag_id INT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (node_id, tag_id))
CREATE TABLE directory_node_aliases (node_id INT NOT NULL, alias_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE directory_tree (node_id, node_name, parent_id, path_text) AS (SELECT n.node_id, n.node_name, n.parent_id, CONCAT('/', n.node_id) FROM directory_nodes AS n WHERE n.parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.node_id, CONCAT(parent.node_name, ' / ', child.node_name), child.parent_id, CONCAT(parent.path_text, '/', child.node_id) FROM directory_tree AS parent INNER JOIN directory_nodes AS child ON child.parent_id = parent.node_id), label_sources AS (SELECT nt.node_id, tc.tag_name AS label FROM directory_node_tags AS nt INNER JOIN directory_tag_catalog AS tc ON tc.tag_id = nt.tag_id WHERE tc.active = 1 UNION SELECT na.node_id, na.alias_name AS label FROM directory_node_aliases AS na), label_lists AS (SELECT node_id, GROUP_CONCAT(label ORDER BY label ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS labels FROM label_sources GROUP BY node_id) SELECT tree.node_id, tree.node_name, tree.path_text, COALESCE(lists.labels, '(none)') AS labels FROM directory_tree AS tree LEFT JOIN label_lists AS lists ON lists.node_id = tree.node_id ORDER BY tree.path_text ASC

checks.sql: SELECT node_id, parent_id, node_name FROM directory_nodes ORDER BY node_id
SELECT tag_id, tag_name, active FROM directory_tag_catalog ORDER BY tag_id
SELECT node_id, tag_id FROM directory_node_tags ORDER BY node_id, tag_id
SELECT node_id, alias_name FROM directory_node_aliases ORDER BY node_id, alias_name
